posts.name: Bailey (Xir/Xir)
posts.cooked:
Greetings and salutations, friends of the forum!

My name is Bailey Pittman (xir/xir), and I am the newest addition here at GTG. My official position is Customer Service and Social Media Manager, so please feel free to reach out to me with any questions or concerns you may have.

As a little about me, I’m a feminine genderqueer individual – and should it be needed my pronouns are pronounced shee/sheer. My background is actually in history and education, but I opted for the board game life to indulge those more geeky tendencies. Board games were not my first passion, though: I’m an RPG fan and gamemaster in my spare time. I’m looking forward to expanding my horizons with all of you as the world of board games is so much larger than I could have expected.

Thanks so much! I hope to hear from you all soon.

posts.name: WalkingTarget
posts.cooked:
Welcome!
If you’re coming to tabletop gaming primarily from an RPG angle, which have been your games of choice (to play or run)?
I know loads of people would say D&D or its derivatives, obviously, but that was never my preference. I came in on Call of Cthulhu back in high school and have played a wide array over the years. I just get curious what other people like.
